name: top-top
description: Top Top by Playcebo Games: TypeScript + Vite, wrapped for Android with Capacitor

scripts.android:debug: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run build && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:dev: npm run build && cap sync android && node tools/dev-shell.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDev
scripts.build:devweb: VITE_CHANNEL=dev vite build && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/version.json', JSON.stringify({commit: process.env.VITE_COMMIT || 'local'}))"
